name: atc-filetree
description: Claude Code mod: the files of your folder in a pane beside the chat (/atc-filetree), with git status, +/- line counts and the branch, the files Claude reads, writes and commits lit up, keyboard navigation, search, open a file (in VS Code on Windows), and files handed to Claude with your next prompt. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

activity.title: Light up Claude's files
activity.description: on: files Claude reads (purple), writes (orange) and commits (green) are lit for two minutes. off: no marks.

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree opens the folders of each file Claude reads or writes and moves the cursor to it. off: the tree stays where you put it.

openAtStart.title: Open at start
openAtStart.description: on: the tree opens when a session starts, once the terminal is 144 columns wide: beside the chat in a fullscreen terminal, above the prompt otherwise. off: open it with /atc-filetree.

column.title: Column
column.description: What the right-hand column shows for each file: age (5m, 3d), size, date, or none.

glyphs.title: Icons
glyphs.description: plain: arrows on folders only, which every terminal draws. nerd: file and folder icons, which need a Nerd Font.
